title: Change impact
evidenceStatus: One authored venue replacement, one successful 300 ms request, four complete Noul scores. All four threshold judgments match a dependency lookup using metadata included in the request. Actual-callback offline probes; no browser or new model calls.
summary: The current request supplies the authored dependencies described as an independent check, so its four matching answers do not establish semantic impact detection. A delayed venue response can attach to an edited date and mislabel two conclusions. Versioned evidence, honest result states and an annotation-free evaluation would preserve the useful source-change interaction.
strengths: Stable conclusion IDs and a readable before/after comparison make the small scenario inspectable.
Draft edits clear badges immediately, and busy/error handling exists.
The published result is complete and retains provider attempts/timing; the live gateway validates every requested answer.

findings.title: The independent dependency check is included in model input
findings.evidence: experience-prototypes/src/new-experiments.tsx:795, :800, :805, :810, :867, :903; scripts/record.ts:97. probes/changes.json reconstructs all 4 saved predictions by intersecting changed fields with supplied depends arrays.
findings.impact: The example cannot distinguish semantic impact detection from reading authored dependency metadata. This is an available shortcut, not proof of causal model reliance.
findings.fix: Withhold annotations from the primary semantic protocol, show the code propagation baseline, and separate supplied-graph/shuffled-graph diagnostics from independent labels.

findings.title: A late response is attached to the edited draft
findings.evidence: experience-prototypes/src/new-experiments.tsx:875, :889, :914; shared.tsx:214. Actual callback probe starts a venue request, edits the date, then installs the old response; travel and reminder disagree with the current draft baseline.
findings.impact: Two of four cards describe the wrong input, and the inspector retains an old run next to current facts even before completion.
findings.fix: Bind runs to immutable input/conclusion hashes and draft revision, abort obsolete work and reject stale commits. Display the submitted snapshot for historical runs.

findings.title: A negative or missing review score is presented as support
findings.evidence: experience-prototypes/src/new-experiments.tsx:852 and :909. A synthetic record with only travel marks the three absent answers Still supported. The actual record is complete; server/gateway.ts:189 rejects incomplete live responses.
findings.impact: Not being flagged for review does not independently prove support, and missing data must not become a reassuring result.
findings.fix: Use explicit current/pending/stale/failed/unknown states and label negative outcomes Not flagged by this check. Evaluate support separately if that claim is needed.

findings.title: Saved evidence lacks exact inputs and differs from the live prompt
findings.evidence: experience-prototypes/scripts/record.ts:18, :27, :103; src/new-experiments.tsx:909; results/changes.jsonl. No state/questions/hashes are stored. Only live requests instruct the model to ignore spelling-only changes; existing files skip recording without compatibility checks.
findings.impact: Current fixtures can be paired with older scores without proof they match, and one venue example does not validate the live protocol or general quality.
findings.fix: Persist exact requests and versions, share a pure builder between live/recording paths, preserve the original record and label reconstructed context honestly.

findings.title: The workflow ends at badges and leaves edit semantics undefined
findings.evidence: experience-prototypes/src/new-experiments.tsx:813, :875, :901. Actual callbacks submit both empty capacity and an exact no-op; no model outcomes were measured for them. There is no conclusion repair, revision history or causal-path interaction.
findings.impact: Visitors cannot close the review loop or distinguish deletion, unchanged meaning and meaningful replacement.
findings.fix: Add explicit edit types, short-circuit exact no-ops, retain deletion as unknown, and provide a revisioned review queue with evidence, causal paths and scoped human decisions.

simulation.title: An event plan that stays current
simulation.description: Edit an event brief beside its invitation, travel note, catering order and reminder. See code-derived candidate dependencies immediately, then inspect semantic review decisions and supporting text. Repair or mark each conclusion reviewed, commit a revision, and fork alternatives from history.
simulation.jevsRole: Judge semantic materiality, indirect references and conditional impact from allowed evidence. Gold annotations stay outside primary model input; known product dependencies are explicitly labeled when supplied.
simulation.codeRole: Own immutable revisions, stable IDs, diffs, known-edge reachability, date arithmetic, per-item status, invalidation, asynchronous guards, scoped overrides, exports and timeline branching.
acceptanceCriteria: Every badge, override and export references its exact source/conclusion revisions; no delayed response can become current for another draft.
No-op edits request zero judgments; explicit deletions and missing/failed responses never imply support.
Revert and fork preserve prior history and restore the correct comparison.
Only affected current conclusions enter the queue, with visible evidence and dependency provenance.
Deterministic reminder-date arithmetic agrees with the current event date.
The graph has a keyboard-accessible list equivalent.

evaluation.design: Author 64 independent eight-conclusion packs, each with eight edit families. Reserve 16 packs for development and 48 for held-out testing, split by scenario/template family. Two independent reviewers label material-review need, support/unknown and evidence, with adjudication. The 384 held-out snapshots have 3,072 conclusion decisions. Run annotation-free input three unchanged times, supplied-graph once and shuffled-graph once: 15,360 primitive decisions and 1,920 eight-question requests before splits/retries. Freeze threshold 0.5 and protocol hashes, retain wrong answers, and retry only transient failures. Use 10,000 paired bootstrap resamples clustered by 48 packs. Provisional gate: at least 90% recall lower bound on determinate affected conclusions and at most 10% false review on semantic no-ops. Separately exercise 1,000 offline schedules across seeds 0–99 and ten event patterns. None of these proposed runs were performed.
baselines: Frozen changed-text overlap with declared normalization.
Exact supplied-graph propagation, explicitly a different information condition.
Independent date/quantity formulas where all assumptions are specified.
metrics: Review precision/recall and exact affected-set accuracy per edit.
False reviews on no-op/formatting/paraphrase edits and unknown-support coverage.
Unchanged-repeat agreement and dependence on supplied/shuffled graph metadata.
Wrong-revision commits, missing-as-supported states, export identity and revert integrity.
All-scheduled and completed coverage, retries, payload size, latency and cost.

coverage.current: One venue replacement, four judgments, four matches to a supplied-metadata code baseline; no date/capacity/compound/no-op/spelling evaluation.
coverage.full: Proposed 48 held-out document packs, 384 edits, 3,072 labeled conclusion outcomes and 15,360 judgments across five passes/conditions; 16 development packs and 1,000 offline integrity schedules.
coverage.feasibility: No external benchmark or official score claimed. Needs independent labeling, exact input capture, a later recording run and provider capacity for 1,920 logical requests. A separate reviewer study is needed before claiming time savings.

libraries.name: React Flow
libraries.use: Already installed; render facts, conclusions and dependency paths while canonical revisions remain separate from transient graph input state. Jev adds semantic impact beyond structural reachability.

libraries.name: jsdiff
libraries.use: Show word/whitespace changes as evidence; leave semantic equivalence to declared rules and Jev rather than treating every text difference as material.

nextSteps.action: Repair dependency-independence claims, stale response commits, result statuses and exact request provenance.
Add independently labeled edit families and annotation-free/supplied/shuffled dependency comparisons.
Build the revisioned impact queue with graph/list views, evidence, repairs and scoped overrides; reuse it for policy-document update review.
